  "decision": {
    "summary": "The investigation has identified several conditions that may have contributed to the instrument-air interruption. The most significant is the blank temporary instruction attachment field on the work package cover (n-kv06wr), which suggests a procedural gap in documenting service-routing changes or valve states. However, this does not prove the physical cause of the pressure drop. Other contributing factors include the area directory's limitation as a location index (n-rww7lb) and lack of documented confirmation of understanding regarding root cause assessment (n-5fesl6). Further evidence is needed to determine whether an unrecorded service-routing change occurred, which valves were affected, and how the crew verified valve states.",
